{{Top|leg}}
The '''Power Surge Loop''' was a mechanism aboard the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] designed to prevent a build up of excess ions. The Loop rerouted the excess ion particles through an emergency bypass back into the [[Microparticle Ion Accelerator]].
